PART 1 — Windows host:
1. mkdir -p C:/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/warsha-wt/v3 then: git -C C:/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha worktree add --detach C:/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/warsha-wt/v3/g0 ba90e713b2731870a7df3c1791bcbfe98e330717
2. Inside that worktree run each command with raw output to the named log (background the long ones; redirect to a file and record the exit code — never pipe a run through tail, it masks failures):
   a. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile > EV/gates/G0.install.log 2>&1
   b. pnpm -r test > EV/gates/G0.unit.log 2>&1 — record the "Tests N passed" line for @warsha/ui, @warsha/client, @warsha/crypto, @warsha/i18n, warsha-remote, warsha-desktop; warsha-desktop_v3 = 0 (no v3 specs exist yet).
   c. cargo test --workspace --all-targets > EV/gates/G0.rust.log 2>&1 — record total passed and ignored. Native Windows runs are expected to work since the 2026-11-08 integrity-label remediation; if 0xC0000142 or temp Access-denied errors appear, stop that part and report an environment blocker — never touch ACLs, integrity labels or the sandbox service.
   d. node scripts/check-arch.mjs ; node scripts/check-engineering-policy.mjs ; node scripts/check-wire-contract.mjs > EV/gates/G0.guards.log 2>&1 — expect exit 0 each and "wire: 9 checks, 0 violations" (W10 arrives later with packet H1).
   e. node EV/tools/versions.mjs . > EV/gates/G0.versions.log 2>&1 — exit 1 is EXPECTED here (the recorded version drift; packet V1 fixes it later). Keep the full output as the truth.

PART 2 — capture host (WSL Ubuntu, root only). Verified working rules — follow exactly:
- Invoke as MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl -d Ubuntu -u root -- bash -lc '<cmd>', and inside export PATH=/root/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin before anything else.
- /root/warsha-visual is the long-lived capture clone carrying about 221 uncommitted entries: NEVER checkout/reset/stash/clean it. Fetching objects into its object store and adding worktrees from it are safe and additive.
- git -C /root/warsha-visual fetch /mnt/c/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha dev (no push), then git -C /root/warsha-visual worktree add --detach /root/warsha-g0-v3 ba90e713b2731870a7df3c1791bcbfe98e330717. If /root/warsha-g0-v3 already exists, inspect it first; reuse only if clean and at that exact commit, otherwise use /root/warsha-g0-v3b.
- In the new worktree: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. The 9 IBM Plex faces, the AA fontconfig pin and chromium-1148 are already installed host-wide; playwright.config.ts pins FONTCONFIG_FILE itself on Linux. Runs must stay on ext4 (/root/...), never /mnt/c.
- Port guard: nothing may listen on 5173 or 5174 (reuseExistingServer: false); check ss -ltn before starting and refuse to start if occupied.
- Run with CI=true so a missing snapshot fails instead of being silently written (workers=2): pnpm exec playwright test --project=desktop --project=remote --reporter=json > /mnt/c/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha/bridge-io/policy/2026-11-09-ui-v3/gates/G0.json 2> /mnt/c/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha/bridge-io/policy/2026-11-09-ui-v3/gates/G0.capture.log — launch detached (setsid ... &) with a .done marker file carrying the exit code; expect about 884 listed (793 desktop + 91 remote) and 15–30 minutes. Never run two Playwright invocations concurrently.
- Then run: node /mnt/c/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha/bridge-io/policy/2026-11-09-ui-v3/tools/pw-gate.mjs failures /mnt/c/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha/bridge-io/policy/2026-11-09-ui-v3/gates/G0.json /mnt/c/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha/bridge-io/policy/2026-11-09-ui-v3/named/R0.txt > /mnt/c/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha/bridge-io/policy/2026-11-09-ui-v3/gates/G0.pw-gate.log 2>&1
- After the run record: git -C <capture-worktree> status --porcelain -- '*-snapshots*' (must print nothing) and the listed/passed/failed counts from G0.json stats.

VERDICT RULES (HANDOVER step 1): zero failures → G0 green, R0 skipped. pw-gate exit 0 with failures all inside named/R0.txt (the v0.2.1 drift: desktop screens.visual/states onboarding-*, providers, settings-providers) → G0 recorded with the named failure list; R0 refresh is then the orchestrator's job (owner stop per OD-U1=review-each). pw-gate exit 1 (any failure outside the set, or a crashed run) → STOP and report the failure list; nothing is refreshed.

FINAL ANSWER (under 400 words + one table): base_counts for the six packages + warsha-desktop_v3 + rust passed/ignored; the three guards results; versions.mjs truth; Playwright listed/passed/failed, pw-gate exit code and the failing case names; every log path you wrote; any blocker classified as product / environment / permission. If you could not execute something, say so explicitly — never report a gate you did not run.
